name: Jack Black Beard Lube(R) Conditioning Shave 6 oz
description: This all-in-one, revolutionary shave formula is a pre-shave oil, shave cream, and skin conditioner. The lightweight, lubricating lotion penetrates whiskers to soften even the toughest beard, while macadamia nut oil and jojoba oil penetrate below the surface of the skin to soften new whisker growth and minimize irritation. The result is a remarkably easy shave, soft skin, and no razor burn. It is formulated Without: - Parabens The unique transparent formula lets you to see where you are shaving, for less risk of nicks and cuts especially important for guys with goatees, mustaches, or sideburns. It's dermatologist tested and is free of fragrance, alcohol, and colorant.
